target: Build the `dopemux-pulse` Claude Code function-hook mod under plugins/dopemux-pulse/: (M1) a status line that shows real ADHD energy and attention from the engine plus the mod's own session minutes, and (M2) a 25-minute focus clock with /focus, /break and /done commands, a band above the prompt, and a toast at the limit.
invariants: Authoring contract: the coordinator loads the `plugin-authoring` skill at dispatch and passes you (a) the path of this build's claude-code.d.ts declaration and (b) the reference notes. Read the declaration for every event, noun and method you use; the API is early access. If it was not supplied, STOP and report.

Files (exactly these): plugins/dopemux-pulse/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/hooks.json, plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.tsx, plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.test.ts, plugins/dopemux-pulse/README.md. The module is one hooks file, exporting `register(on, options)` typed with `Register` from 'claude-code'. Do not write under ~/.claude, do not enable hot reload, do not run `claude plugin install`.

M1 status: in `session.start` start `$.clock.every(60000, ...)` that GETs `<engineUrl>/api/v1/state` via `$.http.fetch` with a short timeout and renders `$.ui.status(...)` as e.g. `🎯 14/25 · ⚡ medium · 🧠 focused`. Read the keys `energy` and `attention` (the engine's current keys), falling back to `energy_level` and `attention_state`. Engine unreachable or malformed => status text says so; toast once on an up->down transition, once on recovery. Session minutes are counted by the mod from `session.start` (the engine's `session_minutes` is always 0).

M2 focus clock: `$.command.register` in `session.start` for `focus` (optional minutes argument, default 25, allowed 5-120), `break`, `done`, answered by `command.run` hooks returning `{ text }`. State in `$.store` or `$.state` as the contract allows (if `$.state` is used, ship types/index.d.ts and name it in plugin.json; that file is then part of the allowlist). A `ui.render` hook on `{ component: 'AbovePrompt' }` shows remaining minutes while a focus block runs and returns `next(e)` when idle. A toast at the limit; a gentler nudge at 90 minutes of continuous focus. All timers cancel on `session.end`.

Configuration: the engine URL comes from `userConfig` in plugin.json when the loaded skill documents it, default `http://127.0.0.1:3025`; otherwise a single constant. No secrets, no auth headers, no other hosts.

Safety: no `$.process.run`, no `$.fs` writes, no `prompt.submit` rewriting, no tool.call hooks, no model calls. Every hook body is wrapped so an exception cannot surface to the user; a failed poll must not throw.

Tests: at least one `*.test.ts` (register.test.ts) covering: status text for healthy/down/alias-key payloads, focus clock arithmetic and the 5-120 bound, toast-once-on-transition, idle band returns next(e). Run `claude plugin validate plugins/dopemux-pulse` and `claude plugin test plugins/dopemux-pulse`, and type-check with `tsc -p` if the types were laid; report each as PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN with the reason.

README.md: what it shows, how to load it (`--plugin-dir plugins/dopemux-pulse`), the config option, the engine dependency, the known limitation that engine energy/attention are inferred from hook activity and are proxy data, and that the mod is read-only.
Live runtime proof (a real session loading the mod against a running engine) is NOT in this packet's reach: report it NOT_RUN and say what the operator must do to see it.
